## 2026-01-20 - Navigable Markdown Reports
**Learning:** Linear Markdown reports generated by scripts become difficult to parse visually as they grow in length. Users struggle to jump between sections like "Recommendations" and "Data".
**Action:** Always include a Table of Contents and "Back to Top" links in generated Markdown reports > 1 screen length. Use explicit HTML anchors (`<a name="..."></a>`) for better compatibility than implicit header slugs.
